answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, forcing a vertex in the network to commit value rather than mere pseudonymous presence. To simulate an island of influence, an attacker must acquire sufficient stake, creating a ferrous grip on consensus resources. This architecture mandates that the cost of an attack scales with the total network valuation, rendering the mass creation of fake agent identities economically prohibitive and mathematically unsustainable.
